description: This file defines the Proxy class in the OpenCart system, providing dynamic property access and method forwarding for models within the system. It acts as a wrapper around model objects, enabling flexible interaction via magic methods.

classes.name: Proxy
classes.description: A dynamic proxy class that forwards property and method calls to underlying data objects, enabling flexible model interaction.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Retrieves a referenced object from the internal data array by key, throws an exception if key is not found.

methods.name: __set
methods.description: Sets an object in the internal data array with the specified key.

methods.name: __isset
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the internal data array.

methods.name: __unset
methods.description: Removes a key-value pair from the internal data array.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Forwards method calls to a data object stored under the method name, or raises an exception if undefined.
